verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching this story is the Replit MCP Server, which lets an external compatible client create, inspect, or update Replit Apps (replit-docs-42). That is a thin, indirect path rather than a documented local-editor workflow. One hands-on report says the user's own git commits clashed with the Replit Agent's git operations, the project got stuck in a loop, and the tooling locked the user out (replit-comm-5). That suggests round-tripping changes exists in some form but is fragile. Missing for 10: documented local development with your own editor and tooling, a documented git push/pull sync back to the platform, conflict handling alongside Agent, and positive independent corroboration.
